feature: shared save across Original, Android14 and Original+Characters profiles

compatibility_basis.runtime_engine: all Vita profiles execute the same original TCBManajer engine
compatibility_basis.original_apk: TCBManajer allocates ConfigData[12906] and _FILELoad/_FILESave read/write save.bin
compatibility_basis.original_plus_characters_apk: TCBManajer also allocates ConfigData[12906] and uses the same _FILELoad/_FILESave contract
compatibility_basis.android14_profile: Vita uses Android14 only as a resource/data profile; save serialization still comes from the original TeaVM engine

migration.runs: once when the shared save does not yet exist and migration marker is absent
migration.selection: newest valid legacy save by mtime; ties prefer selected profile, then original
migration.reset_safety: migration marker prevents deleted shared saves from being resurrected from legacy backups

build.pipeline: TeaVM private C -> VitaSDK ARM ELF -> VELF -> SELF -> VPK

hardware_status: PENDING. Shared-save migration and cross-profile persistence require physical Vita verification.
